# Liber Primus - Page 12

**Status:** ✅ SOLVED

---

## 🟢 Solution

**Plaintext (Modern English):**
```
MOST THINGS ARE NOT WORTH PRESERV
ING:
ADHERENCE: WE FOLLOW DOGMA
SO THAT WE CAN BELONG AND BE RIGH
T. OR WE FOLLOW REASON SO WE CAN
BELONG AND BE RIGHT.
THERE IS NOTHING TO BE RIGHT ABOUT.
TO BELONG IS DEATH.
IT IS THE BEHAVIORS OF CONSUMPT
ION, PRESERVATION, AND ADHEREN
```

**Repository Note:** This page is already plaintext/cleartext in the repo workflow. There is no verified Vigenere key for Page 12. Earlier autogenerated README sections that listed a key length of 83 and hill-climbed runeglish output were artifacts and should not be used.
